source_observations: The required src/WinPDFMerge.Helpers.ps1 helper is loaded by the entry point.
Entry/helper/BAT have no application network, download, or telemetry call.
Selected absolute executable runs directly through CreateProcessW with UseShellExecute false.
Ghostscript fixed rewrite flags retain -dSAFER; GS_OPTIONS removal is child-only, including version probes.
UTF-8-no-BOM logs contain paths, names, engine arguments, PID/timing/failure facts and native streams that can contain PDF metadata.
Control-character escaping does not redact confidential names. Logs are not encrypted or specially access-isolated.
Owned staging inherits normal Windows permissions; owner.json contains run/process/time/known-file facts, and crashes may retain temporary PDFs.
BAT retains its process-scoped Bypass flag; no persistent execution-policy/security-control change exists.
Both project PowerShell source files are NotSigned without signer certificates.
Narrow reference Windows/native/shell observations are not full Explorer, CI, package, release or broad operating-system support certification.
